candidate.title: Unrescued inline feed poll aborts HTTP fallback on embed cache miss
reports: lib/topicretriever.rb:41 — an exception from the inline pollfeed propagates and skips the fetchhttp fallback, so the article is never retrieved.
lib/topicretriever.rb:41 — any feed polling exception aborts the direct-fetch fallback, so one broken feed prevents every uncached embed from loading
lib/topicretriever.rb:37 — every uncached embed url triggers a full feed poll, so concurrent distinct urls repeatedly download and import the whole feed.
lib/topicretriever.rb:41 — an unavailable rss feed aborts retrieval before the http fallback, leaving otherwise reachable articles stuck on the loading screen.
candidate.example: lib/topicretriever.rb:41 — an exception from the inline pollfeed propagates and skips the fetchhttp fallback, so the article is never retrieved.
